findings.text: the renewal thread is owned by the process that published the beat, and the publishing process is the launching door, which reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:3602-3604 says the supervisor outlives; so after a CLI launch the renewal ends at about two seconds and the beat lapses at 90 s while the supervisor and worker are still working, an off-host reader's host_heartbeat.host_is_live returns False, reservation_in_flight answers False for a live holder's reservation, and a second launch on the same attempt is admitted - the defect this node exists to fix, deferred rather than closed, and unfixed for every launch whose door exits.

the freshness assertion cannot distinguish renewal from the process it checks, because the test's beat names the test process itself and _holder_is_running_here at reckon/crew/host_heartbeat.py:174 answers True for it, so the assertion holds with the renewal absent; only the stop_host_heartbeat boolean at :354 detects a missing renewer, and it detects registration rather than the refresh.

the probe's second line reports True on both arms, because the stand-in foreign holder is started in the reader's own process table, so the base revision's local pid probe answers True for the wrong reason and that line cannot discriminate; the record cites it at qwnw-a-reservation-or-lock-holds-only-while-its-holde.html:11 as evidence for the lapsed-beat branch, and the probe script itself is not committed, so a reader cannot see what it did.

the committed gate receipts begin with a pytest progress bar rather than a header naming the revision, the tree and the command, and the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite command fields carry <export> and <worktree> placeholders, so neither the receipt nor the manifest field can be re-run by a later reader.

a renewal that finds its beat file gone breaks out of its loop while leaving its key in _RENEWERS, so _start_renewing at :122 returns early for that (home, host) for the rest of the process's life and a later publish in the same process never renews.

_holder_is_running_here re-implements the pid-namespace and start-time comparison that reckon/crew/host_lease.py:102 already owns, so the two records can drift apart on what 'still running here' means.
